source.publisher: Prime Minister of Australia / Australian Government
source.title: Securing the Future of Bell Bay Aluminium

observations: Australian and Tasmanian governments announced a A$200 million investment over five years supporting continued operation of Rio Tinto-owned Bell Bay Aluminium.
The government states Bell Bay employs 550 workers and supports about 1,000 indirect jobs.
The smelter uses more than 25% of Tasmania's electricity.
The support package is additional to a five-year power deal with Hydro Tasmania.
limits: Source confirms government support and operating context; it does not establish future profitability, subsidy draw, aluminium-price outcomes, consolidated earnings impact, or any Alpha score.
methodology: Methodology 1.0 preserved; no scoring, underwriting, adjudication, canonical mutation, or gate override.
